name: A plan with people in it
goal: Publish an article that says nothing its sources do not. Done when the editor passes the draft against the checklist and the author has published it.
description: A plan, with no harness: an author drafts, an agent checks the facts, an editor judges, and the author publishes. Three of the four steps are a person's. It is the passing document for what amendment A-020 changes in four rules: a person who judges shares no context, a person's own irreversible step needs no gate before it, a person is on no model, and a person needs no capability to leave something behind.

nodes.name: Draft the article
nodes.brief: Write the article from the outline. On a later round, work through the editor's notes.

nodes.name: Check the facts
nodes.brief: For each claim in the draft, find its source and say whether the source supports it. Change nothing in the draft.
outputs: FACTS.md: one line per claim, with its source

nodes.name: Edit
nodes.brief: Judge the draft against the checklist, with the fact check beside it. Pass it or send it back with notes.
outputs: REVIEW.md: one line per checklist item and a verdict

nodes.name: Publish
nodes.brief: Publish the article as the editor passed it.

bar.name: The checklist
bar.acceptance: Every checklist item holds, and every claim in the draft has a source that supports it.
